instruction: Find the cable-bill email my husband sent asking for bills for tax purposes, gather the cable bill PDF attachments from that email thread and any directly related Gmail replies in the same conversation, save them into a single archive named "bills.zip" with each included PDF renamed to the format "MM-YYYY.pdf" based on the bill month, and reply to his email with the note "PFA." attaching the zip file.
